pages.text:
Mm. You are the new one.

Do not stand there, you are blocking the good view of the market.

Course she did.

Watch the fruit stall. No -- do not look at me, look at the stall. The one on the left
has been shorting weight all morning and the one on the right knows it. Neither of
them has said a word. Somebody is going to move first, and whoever moves first has
the corner for the season.

That is it. That is the entire teaching. Everything worth having is already in motion
and mostly unattended. You do not need to be the strongest thing in Ennara. You need
to be the one paying attention when the strongest thing gets tired.

You watch. Waiting is what you call it afterwards, once it has worked.

Sentry, south gate. She will want your name -- give her the short version.
Still watching the stall. It has not happened yet.
